The '''Relatta system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa]], [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn]],<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Rigovia system/Legends|Rigovia systems]]<ref name="Rigovia">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places the [[Rigovia system/Legends|Rigovia system]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] between the [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa]] and [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn systems]], and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' in turn places the Relatta [[Star system/Legends|system]] on that same segment of the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]]; therefore, the Relatta and Rigovia systems must have been connected by it.</ref> and served as the dividing line between the regions known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" />

At one point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'' establishes that [[Noshy Heer]] departed the Relatta [[Star system/Legends|system]] not long before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noshy Heer]] decided to take a short trip to the Relatta [[Star system/Legends|system]] in order to try out [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] at its [[Casino/Legends|casinos]]. He soon lost all of his [[Currency/Legends|money]] at the venues; being unconcerned with that turn of events, however, he found a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was likely to travel to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="Heroes" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Intending to pay for the trip by working aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] during the voyage, Heer then quickly persuaded the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the vessel to take him along, and the freighter departed the Relatta system.<ref name="Heroes" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Relatta system was first mentioned in the [[1995]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', which was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]].<ref name="Heroes" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
